messages:
maya_cs: Morning — HarborEdge week0 preflight. Blockers: BYOK approval pending (CS-9999), partner egress to 44.55.66.0/24 blocked, audit events not arriving to their ELK. Can owners pick up?

kevin_infra: I can do egress. Need CIDR+ports and which private subnets to scope. Will create CR once confirmed.

maya_cs: CIDR 44.55.66.0/24 ports 443 and 9200 (ELK HEC). Subnets: private-a, private-b. Customer prefers NAT GW.

nina_sec: BYOK requires attestation + key ARN. Drafted a minimal key policy restricting usage to redwood runtime and denying Decrypt by console users. Posted to CS-9999 for review. Rotation = 90d, manual rotate enabled per customer request.

leo_ops: Quick ELK smoke (replace token/host if needed):

```
curl -v -XPOST "https://elk.harbor-edge.io:9200/_bulk" -H 'Content-Type: application/x-ndjson' -d '{"index":{}}\n{"msg":"test"}'
```

If you get 200 OK it's accepted. Common failures: TLS CA chain or shippers missing auth header.

deploybot: priv-deploy/harbor-edge v0.3.4 smoke started 2950001130. results: partial-success. failed-tests: audit-forwarding

kevin_infra: Filed change request cr-220 to add egress from private-a/b -> 44.55.66.0/24:443,9200 via ngw-12ab. Propagation ETA ~4m.

leo_ops: Re-ran ELK curl at 2950001152 -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK. Forwarder logs show events received. Uploading evidence to CS-9999.

nina_sec: Security note: if BYOK attestation delayed >48h escalate to compliance reviewer. Also ensure S3 bucket policy includes KMS ARN condition if logs are SSE-KMS.

maya_cs: Renewal sensitivity: AM flagged onboarding velocity as a potential renewal signal. If BYOK + sustained audit delivery not confirmed within 5 business days, mark renewal at-risk and involve finance.

maya_cs: Action items: @nina_sec finalize BYOK attestation checklist; @kevin_infra confirm CR persisted and attach cr-220; @leo_ops monitor ELK for 24h and drop logs. Check-in scheduled 2950087730. :white_check_mark:
